STEP 1 · API METADATA ONLY

Assess the environment

No run required

Approve a site-wide API assessment before selecting a wave. No workbook or datasource files are downloaded. The manual dispatcher allocates an assessment run, then links it here. API metadata can understate artifact-level requirements.

NO ASSESSMENT REQUIRED

One-off conversion

Start from a source

Provide a dashboard URL or an exact project name/LUID. No existing run, assessment or inventory selection is needed. The dispatcher follows the single-workbook/scoped-project workflow and links its allocated run back to this track.

Do not include credentials or access tokens. Queuing starts no process. Normal intake, source resolution, readiness gates and independent validation still apply.

APPROVE, THEN HAND OFF

Create a batch

Queued ≠ running

Select 1–100 exact assessed workbook rows. Investigation downloads selected workbooks plus required published providers, then attempts parsers; it does not convert. NEW conversions repeat survey, assessment and downloads in new runs, without checkpoint reuse. Each workbook gets a separate conversion track/run; group size organizes one or multiple manual wave groups, not process launches. Record investigation requirements in track notes and private evidence references before converting.

Existing assessment review is run-scoped. New wave stages require assessed workbook LUIDs only (max 100). Advanced continuation stages retain the existing run and packages. A dispatcher still resolves intake, exact identity, provider order and gates.
